question: Which NFA variant had the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity, and what was it?
question_long: Which variant of the lithium iron aluminum nickelate (NFA) cathode had the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity, and what was it?
rendered: According to the document, the NFA variant with the lowest first-cycle discharge capacity was NFA-A, which had a discharge capacity of ≈192 mAh g^−1.

prompt.system: You answer questions about one document, "Lithium Iron Aluminum Nickelate, LiNixFeyAlzO2—New Sustainable Cathodes for Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Li-Ion Batteries", using only what that document contains.
